packet.title: XPath and XQuery conformance sweep (implementation)
packet.summary: Fixes "//" paths, XSLT globals in inline functions, default collations, library static contexts, fn:load-xquery-module variables, lax xml:id and XML 1.1 query text.

body.p: After . From fresh whole runs (XP40 40 failed and 30 wrong-error passes, XQ40 138 and 49), with 's open list: XSLT's per-element default collation, fn:load-xquery-module singletons, xml:id under lax validation, IDREF checks at a validation root, XQuery's XML 1.1 lexing ('s design), serialization singletons; first the "//" path bug 4.26 found and XSLT globals in inline functions (orchestrator). Verification as says. Done 2026-10-20 (): "//" paths, XSLT globals at call time, place default collations, library static contexts, load-xquery-module's variables, vendor-options and trust, context-dependent references, lax xml:id, XML 1.1 query text; XP40 32,793 to 32,797 passed, XQ40 46,070 to 46,101, XT40 +13, none lost.
